trial_court: Adhoc Additional District Judge, Jalgaon, Spl.M.P. No. 9/2006
case_name: Sau Varsha W/O Pravin Patil vs Pravin Madhukar Patil

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sau Varsha w/o Pravin Patil, wife
parties.respondent_defendant: Pravin Madhukar Patil, husband at present Bostan, America

facts_of_case: Love marriage between parties did not sail smoothly and fell on rocks within a short span. Appellant Varsha and respondent Pravin are inhabitants of same locality. Marriage was registered in 2000. Respondent left native town to join service, then completed post graduation and worked as Software Engineer.

legal_principles.principle: Desertion means the intentional permanent forsaking and abandonment of one spouse by the other without that other's consent, and without reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: In its essence desertion means the intentional permanent forsaking and abandonment of one spouse by the other without that other's consent, and without reasonable cause. It is a total repudiation of the obligations of marriage.
cited_cases: Bipin Bipin Chander v. Prabhawati, (1956) AIR 1756

legal_principles.principle: The essential ingredients of the matrimonial offence of 'desertion' are: (i) the factum of separation; and (ii) the intention to bring cohabitation permanently to an end — animus deserendi.
legal_principles.held: The essential ingredients of the matrimonial offence of 'desertion' are: (i) the factum of separation; and (ii) the intention to bring cohabitation permanently to an end — animus deserendi.

outcome.final_order: Divorce granted to respondent by learned Adhoc Additional District Judge, Jalgaon on ground of desertion.
